name: John J. Meehan
tagline: Top rated Civil Rights attorney in New York, New York
side_practice_areas: Civil Rights, Employment & Labor, Personal Injury
about: Partner at Norinsberg Law in New York City, New York, John J. Meehan advocates for individuals in matters of civil rights law, employment and labor law, and personal injury law. Dedicated to being the voice of those who are voiceless, he stands by his clients throughout the lengthy process of trial, supporting them and guiding them through such uncertain times. Extending his practice to people across the metropolitan area, he effectively handles cases of car accidents. premises liability, construction accidents, medical malpractice, products liability and wrongful death.

Upon receiving his Juris Doctor from New York Law School in 2012, Mr. Meehan gained his licensure to practice law in New York in the next year. Striving for his clients ever since, he has counseled clients in several cases. Further admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York, he stops at nothing to ensure the support his clients need.

Prior to his tenure at the current firm, Mr. Meehan gained invaluable experience at The Brooklyn District Attorney's Office, where he was responsible for prosecuting a diverse range of criminal cases. His experience in this role not only refined his legal knowledge but also enriched his comprehension of the intricate dynamics within the justice system, equipping him with the necessary tools to vigorously champion the rights and interests of his clients today.

Having tried numerous cases to verdict throughout his career, Mr. Meehan has been an important part of the firm’s trial team and has won millions of dollars in both verdicts and settlements for his clients. He was recently featured in the six-part documentary produced by Jay-Z, Spike TV’s Time: The Kalief Browder Story, which focuses on the abuses of New York City’s criminal justice system.
honors: Named a Rising Star by Super Lawyers Magazine
